en-US.shortDescription: Explore pediatric clinical tools and interactive learning scenarios through Alexa+.
en-US.fullDescription: PedsCore AI is an educational pediatric clinical learning add-on. It helps users discover structured pediatric scores and tools, inspect their required inputs and evidence metadata, and execute supported calculations through deterministic PedsCore logic. The conversational layer orchestrates the interaction; clinical calculations are performed by validated application code rather than generated by a language model. Interactive emergency and mass-casualty simulation workflows are planned as the next integration stage. This experience is intended for education and training and is not a substitute for professional clinical judgment.
examplePhrases: Find a pediatric score for assessing croup severity
